name: Fossil CO₂ emissions per person (tonnes of CO₂)
line: The Global Carbon Project’s figure, not the World Bank’s: fossil CO₂ alone (coal, oil, gas, cement, flaring and other carbonates), in tonnes of CO₂ per person, 1820–2025. The World Bank’s series is CO₂ excluding land use, in tonnes of CO₂ equivalent, from EDGAR and the IEA, so the two differ.
notDrawn: the Global Carbon Project’s 4 rows that are not a country of today
